title: Go Programming
description: Master Go (Golang), static typing, goroutines, channels, interfaces, packages, and high-concurrency backend services.

nodes.title: Foundations of Go
nodes.description: Go toolchain setup, main package, variable declarations, primitive types, and control flow.

children.title: Introduction to Go & Setup
children.description: Installing Go, GOPATH, Go modules (go mod init), and main entry point.

children.title: Variables, Constants & Data Types
children.description: Short variable declaration (:=), basic types, type conversion, and iota constants.

children.title: Control Flow (if, switch, for)
children.description: If initializer syntax, expression-less switch, and Go's single loop construct (for).

nodes.title: Data Structures & Structs
nodes.description: Arrays, slices, maps, structs, and pointer semantics in Go.

children.title: Slices & Array Internals
children.description: Slice header (pointer, length, capacity), make(), append() reallocation behavior, and reslicing.

children.title: Maps & Key-Value Lookups
children.description: Creating maps, comma-ok idiom, iterating over maps, and map deletion.

children.title: Structs & Methods
children.description: Defining structs, anonymous fields, value vs pointer receiver methods.

nodes.title: Concurrency in Go
nodes.description: Goroutines, Channels, Select statements, Mutexes, and WaitGroups.

children.title: Goroutines & M:N Scheduler
children.description: Lightweight thread execution, go keyword, stack size allocation, and Go runtime scheduler.

children.title: Channels (Unbuffered vs Buffered)
children.description: Channel creation, directional channels, blocking send/receive, and closing channels.

children.title: Select Statement & Timeouts
children.description: Non-blocking channel communication, multiplexing with select, and time.After timeouts.
